## Change control

- [ ] The issue is linked when applicable and its acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated for a releasable change, or is not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility claims match the implementation.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the Developer Certificate of Origin.
- [ ] Remaining uncertainty and follow-up issues are explicit.
